policy: A trustworthy official government text or page may be accepted as an external reference within the publisher, language, version or observed date, legal status, subject, and passages actually checked. Government-published consolidated texts are acceptable working references when their identity and scope are clear; Gazette-fragment reconstruction, a local copy, conversion, hashes, or an updater are not prerequisites for link use. If currentness, publisher trust, or scope remains unclear, leave the reference unresolved and offer the whole official website for human review. External-link acceptance does not accept a local conversion, establish topic adequacy, or complete the country review.

external_reference_decisions.accepted_role: Official German Fedlex consolidation of the Foreign Nationals and Integration Act (AIG), SR 142.20, dated 15 October 2023. Use as a dated primary-law reference for the inspected scope, including Article 2's relationship between the Act and applicable treaty rules.
not_accepted: The older English translation or any translation as controlling Swiss law.
Any captured Markdown as a semantically verified or complete copy.
A claim that this edition contains every amendment currently in force in October 2026.
Complete coverage of the AIG, Swiss-national family cases, or the Swiss legal-source pack.

evidence.verified_content: Act identity, Article 1 scope, Article 2 treaty relationship, and displayed version date.
evidence.limitations: Accept the displayed official edition as a dated reference only. Recheck Fedlex for a later consolidation or relevant amendment before relying on current law; the displayed status date alone does not establish that no later applicable change exists.

external_reference_decisions.accepted_role: Official Fedlex reference for the Entry and Visa Ordinance (VEV), SR 142.204. The checked record identifies the instrument as in force and displays a German consolidation dated 12 June 2026; use it for that identified, dated entry-and-visa reference.
not_accepted: A verified local text extraction or complete semantic transcription from the JavaScript-dependent record.
Currentness after the displayed 12 June 2026 status date without rechecking Fedlex.
Topic completeness for entry, Schengen visas, national visas, or residence authorization.

evidence.version: Displayed consolidation status 2026-06-12; record marked in force when checked.
evidence.verified_content: Instrument title and identifier SR 142.204, in-force status, displayed date, and Article 1 subject description in official Fedlex results.
evidence.limitations: The browser interface did not render the full body in this research client. Open the official record directly for provision-level review and recheck later changes.

external_reference_decisions.accepted_role: Official French Fedlex consolidation of the Ordinance on the Free Movement of Persons (OLCP/VFP), SR 142.203, dated 1 January 2026. Use as a dated official-language reference for the implementing ordinance and its stated AFMP relationship.
not_accepted: A claim that the French edition is the latest available in every official language.
Any local conversion as a semantically validated complete text.
Complete coverage of AFMP, EFTA Convention, or all EU/EFTA family routes.

evidence.verified_content: Instrument identity, displayed edition date, and preamble reference to implementation of the Agreement on Free Movement of Persons.
evidence.limitations: The browser interface did not render the full body in this research client. Recheck Fedlex for later versions and review the relevant article in the applicable language before reliance.

external_reference_decisions.accepted_role: Official German Fedlex PDF of the Federal Act on Administrative Procedure (VwVG), SR 172.021, dated 1 July 2022. Use as a dated reference for the inspected federal-authority scope and the recorded Articles 46a and 50 remedies.
not_accepted: Any claim that the 2022 edition is the latest consolidation or includes every later amendment.
A general cantonal residence-permit procedure code or a universal 30-day appeal deadline.
Any unreviewed local Markdown conversion as a semantically complete text.

evidence.verified_content: Article 1 federal-authority scope, Article 46a refusal/delay remedy, Article 50 30-day appeal period within the Act's scope, and displayed date.
evidence.limitations: Use only within the Act's federal scope. Currentness after 1 July 2022 and the rules of each canton require separate checks.

external_reference_decisions.accepted_role: Official FDFA source for the AFMP's stated entry-into-force date and the official route to the German treaty text hosted on Fedlex.
not_accepted: Uninspected treaty articles, annexes, protocols, or a complete consolidated AFMP text.
A claim that the AFMP makes Switzerland an EEA member.
Complete coverage of the treaty rights for any individual sponsor or family-member situation.

evidence.version: Live FDFA page; published 2025-01-16; no page-specific revision date observed.
evidence.verified_content: FDFA states that the AFMP entered into force on 1 June 2002 and provides a link labelled 'Text of the agreement (de)'.
evidence.limitations: The linked treaty body was not rendered in the research client. Recheck the linked Fedlex record and current treaty status before relying on substantive provisions.

external_reference_decisions.accepted_role: Official EFTA institutional page establishing that Switzerland is an EFTA state but is not a party to the EEA Agreement. Use only for the jurisdictional distinction between Swiss bilateral/EFTA routes and EEA membership.
not_accepted: The text or substantive content of the EFTA Convention.
A complete description of AFMP, Swiss domestic law, or individual family-member rights.
A dated legal consolidation; the page did not expose a revision date.

evidence.version: Live EFTA institutional page; no revision date observed.
evidence.verified_content: The official page names Iceland, Liechtenstein, and Norway as EEA EFTA states and expressly says Switzerland is not party to the EEA Agreement.
evidence.limitations: This is an institutional status explanation, not treaty text. It is a supplemental jurisdictional reference outside the original 44-record capture inventory.

external_reference_decisions.accepted_role: Official SEM guidance for the EU/EFTA route stating that cantons issue permits and directing applicants to cantonal authorities for forms, filing location, and timing.
not_accepted: A uniform application process for all 26 cantons.
Swiss-national FNIA, ordinary third-country, UK acquired-rights, or mission-specific procedures.
The captured Markdown as a semantically verified complete copy.

evidence.verified_content: Cantons issue permits; applicants are directed to the competent cantonal authority for procedural details.
evidence.limitations: This is route-specific operational guidance. It links to local authorities but does not itself establish each canton's forms, appointments, evidence requirements, or remedies.

external_reference_decisions.accepted_role: Official SEM directory for locating cantonal immigration and employment-market authorities, including official linked canton sites.
not_accepted: A complete local procedure or remedy map for each canton.
The directory as proof that all linked authority pages or contact details are current after its displayed date.
Any local copy or conversion as a validated complete source.

evidence.verified_content: Directory title, official canton authority entries and links; Geneva and Zurich entries sampled.
evidence.limitations: Use as a discovery directory only. Check the relevant canton website for current forms, appointments, filing requirements, fees, and appeals.

external_reference_decisions.accepted_role: Official SEM Entry FAQ for the distinct visa-refusal objection procedure: written and reasoned objection within 30 days, with a filing route through SEM or a Swiss representation in the stated circumstances.
not_accepted: A general appeal route or deadline for cantonal residence-permit decisions.
A substitute for the refusal notice or current governing law.
Mission-specific appointment or document requirements not stated on the FAQ.

evidence.verified_content: Written statement of grounds, 30-day period, and specified filing channels for a visa refusal.
evidence.limitations: This acceptance applies to the current SEM page URL and its visa-refusal guidance, not to the older captured FAQ URL or a local conversion. Follow the individual notice and recheck fees and route details.

external_reference_decisions.accepted_role: Official Swiss Parliament docket 26.023 as a repeatable legislative-status and dependency-monitoring route for the Bilateral III package.
not_accepted: An operative law, ratified treaty status, or proof that a particular protocol has entered into force.
A substitute for the official treaty text, enactment, referendum, or commencement record.
Any completeness determination for the full legislative package.

evidence.version: Docket updated 2026-10-19 21:16; status shown as 'Plusieurs projets en délibération'.
evidence.verified_content: Official docket title, update timestamp, and deliberation status.
evidence.limitations: The docket is a status route, not enacted law. Recheck the official treaty and law publications before treating any proposal as operative.

external_reference_decisions.accepted_role: Official FAC page explaining the Court's publication policy and linking to its searchable decisions database. Use to understand and discover published FAC decisions, while carrying the Court's stated coverage limits.
not_accepted: An exhaustive corpus of all FAC decisions or every relevant Swiss court decision.
A substitute for searching the Federal Supreme Court and cantonal court portals.
Any substantive case holding or complete case-law review.

evidence.version: Live official page; no revision date exposed.
evidence.verified_content: The FAC says substantive judgments are published, procedural decisions are published only if of general public interest, reference judgments do not cover every field, and the page links the FAC judgments database.
evidence.limitations: The Court does not guarantee completeness and accuracy of internet information. The database contains all published decisions, which is not the same as all decisions made.

external_reference_decisions.accepted_role: Official SEM procedural directive for specified third-country family-reunification routes under the AIG and Asylum Act. It identifies the handoff between Swiss representations, cantonal migration authorities, and SEM.
not_accepted: Family members within the EU-Switzerland AFMP route; the directive expressly excludes that route.
A complete source of binding eligibility law or a replacement for the AIG, VZAE, OEV, or Asylum Act.
A complete cantonal application, appointment, fee, or remedy map.
The separate country-list PDF as an independently reviewed source.
The captured French Markdown conversion as an accepted local copy.

evidence.language: de; official French parallel version also available
evidence.version: SEM Directive No. 322.3-12 dated 2025-12-04; its official parent index was last modified 2025-12-12 and currently links the directive and a separate country list.
evidence.verified_content: The 18-page directive is addressed to Swiss foreign representations and cantonal migration authorities. For family reunification under AIG Articles 42 ff., the representation conducts preliminary review and forwards the application; the canton examines and decides, with SEM approval reserved in some cases. It separately describes routes for temporarily admitted persons and refugees and states that AFMP family reunification is outside its scope.
evidence.limitations: Use the parent index to resolve the current PDF and its separately linked country list. This is official operational guidance, not the statutory basis. Do not apply it to AFMP/EU-EFTA family routes or infer all 26 cantonal requirements from it.

human_review_offers.review_scope: Review the whole official federal-law portal for current consolidated German, French and Italian texts, the exact current version for each identified SR/ELI record, the meaning of displayed dates, legal status, and the relevant Official Compilation or current consolidated record.
human_review_offers.reason: The cited Fedlex records are accepted only within displayed dates and scoped passages; several page bodies were not rendered by the research client, and this review did not establish current versions for the full candidate inventory.

human_review_offers.review_scope: Review the full SEM guidance and directives site for route-specific instructions, procedures, forms, visa and residence-card distinctions, and updates to the current EU/EFTA and visa-refusal pages.
human_review_offers.reason: The accepted 2025 directive clarifies missions, SEM, and cantonal handoffs for specified third-country routes but excludes AFMP family cases; other sponsor routes, remedies, current forms, and local steps remain open.

human_review_offers.review_scope: Review the Swiss representations directory and relevant post websites for mission competence, appointment routes, outsourcing, checklists, fees, document requirements, and visa submission channels.
human_review_offers.reason: The candidate inventory includes Istanbul as one example only; no all-mission review was done.

human_review_offers.review_scope: Review the linked official migration-authority sites for all 26 cantons, recording competent authority, EU/EFTA and other family routes, forms, appointments, filing, fees, and remedy links.
human_review_offers.reason: SEM provides an official authority directory, but this review did not inspect each canton procedure.

human_review_offers.review_scope: Review the FAC jurisprudence site and linked judgment database for issue-based case-law discovery, search limits, publication rules, and citations.
human_review_offers.reason: The Court confirms publication limits and does not guarantee completeness of its online information.

human_review_offers.review_scope: Review the Federal Supreme Court's official law and decision search routes and identify the relevant appealable migration decisions and date coverage.
human_review_offers.reason: The candidate source's configured capture failed TLS verification; do not bypass that error, and do not infer completeness from a search page.

human_review_offers.review_scope: Review the full official parliamentary docket and linked records for Bilateral III, including subsequent decisions and any procedural stages relevant to AFMP changes.
human_review_offers.reason: The current docket is a status snapshot and does not establish enactment, referendum outcome, or commencement.

human_review_offers.review_scope: Review Federal Office of Justice materials for civil-status recognition, ombudsman coverage, and relevant family-status procedures; follow current linked cantonal sources.
human_review_offers.reason: Family-status, oversight, and current local ombuds coverage remain open in the candidate inventory.
